body:
Those who have been part of the EMC tour will remember the video produced by the Sierra Club about faith-based efforts to combat mountaintop removal in Appalachia. Canada has a parallel problem – strip mining for tar sands. You can download a powerpoint presentation with some photographs of what that process involves near the bottom of this webpage.

Caring for God’s beautiful creation means we must develop renewable energy. Check out this initiative at everythingmustchange.org – and don’t miss the links on the right. We have a long way to go, but committed people are using their God-given intelligence and creativity to find solutions that will benefit everyone.
